_comment: Copy to config/homelab.json. devices: important devices by host (ping) or entity (Home Assistant tracker); critical = report during quiet hours too. limits: fixed limits from which Jarvis reports. kuma_skip: Uptime Kuma monitors that Jarvis already checks itself (no double report); kuma_critical: report at night too. security_announce: which severities of the security centre Jarvis announces on his own. energy: what the energy loop needs (automations: seconds since the last run, 0 = only has to be switched on).

maintenance._comment: Maintenance calendar: certs = host:port whose TLS certificate Jarvis checks (report cert_warn_days before); docker_max_days = age of a container image on the Pi from which a pull is due; backup_max_days = age of the last Hyper Backup run from which he reminds
